game_title: Edge Case Hunter – Buried Temple Steps Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Edge Case Hunter: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Find inputs like 0, empty lists, and negative numbers that break otherwise correct code. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the edge_cases value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about edge_cases to power up the camel trader and open the camel pen.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Edge Case Hunter
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
